name: 3D Tibi anatomical acceptance tests (scripts/anatomy3d-check.js)
purpose: Checks connected/closed skin, separate non-manifold counts, internal envelope and selected layer rays, local sheet relief, normals, registration, deformation and actual surface colour/garment ownership. It does not certify human anatomy.
capabilities: Exact position/color/colorC recovery after a nearby pose, exposing history-dependent skin caches
--profile legacy|distance (distance default); torso stations must meet the core contour within half a mesh cell
Zero boundary edges; broad bounded lat relief and no elevation-only inflation; biceps > brachialis > humerus ray
Exact morph normals, cross-instance isolation, bounded RGB for all three roles and no top colour on arm-dominated vertices
Actual posed shoulder crest and neutral upper-arm/lower-arm/palm silhouette clearance, including unmasked supporting volumes

compatibility.runtime: python3.12 or node; ffmpeg where noted
compatibility.notes: Node-only checks. Existing thresholds remain; the current profile gains stricter local gates and a zero-open-boundary rule. Legacy is an explicit compatibility reference with documented defects. Mac rerun pending.

security.notes: Writes only under qa/ or the named output directory.

approval_evidence: 0.5.0, Windows 2026-11-20: both current bodies pass; the anatomy suite has 23 passing tests. Restoring the joint orb, flat arm root or forward-hanging neutral stance makes the actual silhouette gate fail. Zero boundary edges; three male/four female non-manifold edges remain reported separately. These are engineering guards, not clinical approval. Mac rerun pending.

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.
